description: Explicit rank-complete bridge ledger for Gate 471. The Cabibbo target is a PDG-style bridge comparator target. The I_spec/I_K values and branch tags are explicitly supplied external ASHA bridge comparators; I_K and branch tags are not PDG-published quark-mass invariants and are not native ASHA laws.
